title: Explicit Renewal of a Small Business Electricity Supply Agreement: Care Desk Standard
content:
**Standard.** A Small Business Electricity Supply renewal is accepted only on an active agreement, as shown by the agreement record's status. When the acceptance is made on or before the contract end date, the new term starts the day after the contract end date; when it is made after a rollover, the new term starts on the acceptance date. When the business agreement has already rolled over, a renewal acceptance is honoured only when the business accepts no later than the plan's post-expiry grace days (15 calendar days on every plan) after the rollover took effect on the plan change date. Day one is the calendar day after the plan change date, and the grace period closes at the end of the calendar day equal to the plan change date plus 15 days.

## Start of the new term

| Acceptance made | New term starts |
|---|---|
| on or before the contract end date | the day after the contract end date |
| after the agreement rolled over, inside the grace period | the acceptance date |

## Grace period after rollover (hypothetical dates)

The rollover took effect on 1 January, the plan change date on the agreement record.

| Acceptance date | Day of the grace period | Honoured |
|---|---|---|
| 2 January | day one | yes |
| 16 January | last day | yes |
| 17 January | after the period closed | no |

## Status

| Agreement status | Renewal acceptance |
|---|---|
| active (including an agreement that rolled over to month-to-month) | may be accepted, subject to the grace period where it has rolled over |
| drop pending, closed, enrollment pending | not accepted |

## Retired clauses

The following clauses are **no longer in force**; each has been superseded and is not applied:

- "A business renews explicitly by accepting the offer in the governing renewal notice: the agreement takes the offered plan, its term in months and the offered renewal rate, and the renewal election becomes accepted."
- "Each explicit renewal earns one renewal loyalty credit equal to the renewal loyalty credit of the plan renewed into; an automatic renewal earns none."

superseded_clauses: A business renews explicitly by accepting the offer in the governing renewal notice: the agreement takes the offered plan, its term_months and the offered renewal rate, and renewal_election becomes accepted.
Each explicit renewal earns one renewal_loyalty_credit equal to the renewal_loyalty_credit_usd of the plan renewed into; an automatic renewal earns none.
